question: A cone of height 22 cm and diameter 20 cm is mounted on a hemisphere of the same diameter. Find the volume of the solid formed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Volume = Volume of Cone + Volume of Hemisphere

V = (1/3) × π × r² × (h + 2r)

Substitute radius r = 10 cm and height h = 22 cm:

V = (1/3) × (22/7) × 100 × (22 + 20) = (2200 / 21) × 42 = 4400 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4400 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the cone (h) = 22 cm

Diameter of the solid (d) = 20 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 10 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee1742bee51ffb9a43253c21491508119990339f69ae1551f2d042cc44e52237.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Volume = [(1/3) × π × r² × h] + [(2/3) × π × r³]

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × π × r² × (h + 2r)

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (10)² × (22 + 2 × 10)

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 100 × (22 + 20)

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 100 × 42

⇒ Total Volume = 2200 × (42 / 21)

⇒ Total Volume = 2200 × 2 = 4400 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4400 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

A cylinder's volume is V = π × r² × h. A cone is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the exact same base and height.

Surface Area of Cone

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = π × r × l, where slant height l = √(r² + h²). Total Surface Area = π × r × (r + l).

Surface Area of Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × r². Total Surface Area (including the flat circular base) = 3 × π × r².
